_about: D-09 issue/description/page version behaviour. Ported from 01a93e17216faea7bfc156b0f864cbbe420d1c52
_method: Values produced by executing the named Python code under pi_dash.settings.test with no DB/S3/mongo (venv /tmp/ct100-django-venv). Cutoff timestamps frozen at 2026-09-28T06:00:00+00:00; production uses timezone.now(). Generators: /tmp/fx_d09b.py, /tmp/fx_d09c.py (throwaway).

issue_task.diff: updated_issue JSON parsed (falsy -> {}); per key: getattr(issue, key) != value keeps the key (unknown keys raise AttributeError -> broad except -> log_exception, return None).
issue_task.coalesce: Latest IssueVersion by -last_saved_at; same owner (str-compared) AND age <= 600s -> setattr each changed key + last_saved_at=now, save(update_fields=[changed..., 'last_saved_at']); else IssueVersion.log_issue_version(issue, user_id). No changes -> no write. Issue.DoesNotExist -> silent return.

get_owner_id.admin_fallback: ProjectMember.objects.filter(project_id, role=20).first() -> member_id or None (DB path; role 20 = Admin literal).

get_related_data.activities: IssueActivity filter order (issue_id, -created_at), groupby, FIRST per issue -> {id: activity.id}.

create_issue_version.field_notes: owned_by resolved via get_owner_id; activity from related.activities.get(issue.id) (None ok); properties/meta via getattr(issue, ..., {}) (missing attr -> {}); cycle may be None; last_saved_at = now. Returns UNSAVED instance.

sync_issue_version.flow: atomic; total = Issue.objects.count(); 0 -> return; end=min(offset+batch, total); batch = order_by(created_at) select_related(workspace, project) [offset:end_offset]; empty -> return; related=get_related_data(ids); per-issue create (skip Nones); bulk_create(batch_size=1000) iff non-empty; end<total -> apply_async(kwargs={batch_size, offset=end, countdown}, countdown=countdown).

sync_issue_description_version.flow: atomic; count; end=min(...); batch order_by(created_at) select_related(workspace, project).only(*fields)[offset:end]; per issue: skip (warning) when workspace/project missing or owner None; else append IssueDescriptionVersion(...last_saved_at=now); bulk_create (NO batch_size) iff non-empty; chain next batch identically.

should_update_existing_version.trap: 'if not version: return' yields None, NOT False — falsy either way, but port the exact None.

update_existing_version: Copies description_json/html/binary/stripped from the LIVE issue onto the version + last_saved_at=now; save(update_fields=[4 description fields, last_saved_at]); returns None.

issue_description_version_task.skip: current.description_html == live.description_html AND NOT is_creating -> return None (is_creating=True forces a version even when unchanged).
issue_description_version_task.flow: atomic; latest version by -last_saved_at; should_update_existing_version(latest, user_id) -> update else log_issue_description_version(issue, user_id). Issue.DoesNotExist -> silent; bad JSON -> log 'Invalid JSON for updated_issue: ...'.

track_page_version.update_path: latest by -last_saved_at, same owner (str), age <= 600 -> copy 4 description fields + sub_pages_data={} (ALWAYS {}, never carried over); save(update_fields=[html, binary, json, stripped, sub_pages_data, 'updated_at']) — note updated_at, NOT last_saved_at.
track_page_version.create_path: PageVersion(page, workspace, 4 description fields, owned_by=user_id, last_saved_at=now, sub_pages_data={}).
track_page_version.prune: count > 20 -> delete oldest by last_saved_at (ONE row per run). Page.DoesNotExist -> silent return.

issue_task.before: Issue row + 0..n versions; latest version owned by U saved T ago.
issue_task.after: Changed keys only: same-owner-and-fresh -> latest version row updated in place; else one new IssueVersion row.

sync_issue_version.after: One IssueVersion per issue with resolvable owner (bulk_create batch 1000); chains next offset while end < total.

track_page_version.before: Page with changed description_html; K versions.
track_page_version.after: K+1 versions iff no fresh same-owner version (else updated in place); at most one prune delete when K+1 > 20.
